openings.claim: Use a row-preserving ledger: normalize only with supplied U=5V conversion, retain originals and every duplicate, unmatched or superseded row. Inclusion depends on supported lineage, status meaning and cutoff eligibility; exclude contributions only through explicit replacement relationships.
openings.discriminator: Against summing normalized rows with quantity-based deduplication, expose competing interpretations of the early-effective amendment and differently identified replacement, avoiding deletion of legitimate equal-quantity transfers or double-counting corrections.
openings.probe: Freeze clean/disturbed variants before opening sealed key; within extra twenty minutes compare resolved batches, unsupported definite claims and request counts, inspecting the ambiguous amendment. Defeat: unsupported definite quantity, any lost row, or twelve-batch review exceeding sixty minutes.
openings.uncertainty: Links may not establish cross-report identity; unproven equivalence remains an explicit alternative and bounded disagreement. Implementation capacity and speed advantage are unestablished.
